page.overview:
Who is Impresario?

The Impresario is a non-player character in Final Fantasy XIV, being a relevant character at the All Saints' Wake seasonal event. He is the manager and stage director who leads the Continental Circus, a voidsent circus troupe that hosts the festivities in the three city-states of Eorzea.

However, this is a façade to realize his real plan: the "Night of Devilry", a mythical night in which an army of demons go into the mortal realm. However, his attempts are always foiled every year by the Warrior of Light.

For the celebration of All Saints' Wake, the Continental Circus has been summoned to Gridania to revive traditions that have fallen into disuse since the Calamity. The Shifty Thespian invited the Warrior of Light to speak with the Impresario. After recounting the origins of All Saints' Wake, the Impresario presented the Warrior of Light with a traditional costume, so they could take their place among the costumed troupers and help put on a frightfully delicious evening..}}

The Impresario encouraged the Warrior of Light to travel to each of the three city-states and scare the artists he encountered. As the festivities continue, the Impresario was impressed with the Warrior of Light's efforts and asked for help with another All Saints' Wake tradition: the lighting of the traditional protective lanterns. Pleased with the efforts, the Impresario entrusted the task of placing one last protective lantern in a poorly lit area near Apkallu Falls.
